extraction.Name: Emily Swallow
extraction.Refused/Protested: There was no one to whom I could protest at the time but I did not want it and told my father so.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged it to Mr. Dougherty for $1275 and then sold it to The Floete Lumber Company for $480. I then turned the proceeds over to my father for a quarter section of land. No, I sold it for $900.00.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Mr. Dougherty for $1275; sold to The Floete Lumber Company for $480
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I wanted to keep my land but the taxes were too much for me.
extraction.NOTES: Patent was sent by mail in 1920; allottee did not sign a receipt (not that she remembers); proceeds from sale turned over to father for a quarter section of land; no dependents; in good health; document references numbers 2992 and what appear to be additional file reference numbers; subscribed and sworn before A. S. W.
